author: GunsNPrices
description: MCP server for gun and ammo shopping: parse product titles, identify firearm models and calibers, cost per round, and GunsNPrices price comparison links.
name: GunsNPrices

tools.name: parse_product_title
tools.title: Parse a gun or ammo product title
tools.description: Parse a firearm or ammunition product title from any store into structured data: firearm or ammo, brand, model (50 brands, e.g. 'Glock 19 Gen 5 MOS'), calibers, magazine capacity, barrel length in inches, rounds per box and, with a price, cost per round. Also returns GunsNPrices pages to compare current prices.

title.description: Product title as a store shows it, e.g. 'Glock 19 Gen5 MOS 9mm 4.02in 15rd'

brand.description: Manufacturer, if known (helps when the title doesn't name it)

price.description: Listing price in USD; for ammo it gives cost per round

tools.name: identify_firearm_model
tools.title: Identify a firearm model
tools.description: Identify the brand, model family and exact model of a firearm from a title or a short description (e.g. 'G19 Gen5 MOS', 'Sig P365 XL', 'S&W M&P Shield Plus'). Covers 50 brands including Glock, Sig Sauer, Smith & Wesson, Ruger, Springfield, Beretta, Taurus, Mossberg, Remington, Savage and Henry. Glock part numbers (e.g. PA195S203) are decoded too. Returns GunsNPrices pages for the model, its family and the brand.

tools.name: lookup_caliber
tools.title: Look up a caliber
tools.description: Normalize a caliber or cartridge name ('9mm Luger', '5.56 NATO', '300 BLK', '12ga', '6.5 CM') or find every caliber mentioned in a text. Returns the standard name, type (handgun, rifle, rimfire, shotgun, airgun, muzzleloader) and the GunsNPrices page comparing ammo prices for it.

query.description: Caliber name or any text that mentions calibers

tools.name: cost_per_round
tools.title: Ammo cost per round
tools.description: Compute the cost per round of an ammo listing from its price and round count. If the round count is not given, it is read from the title ('50/Box', '1,000 Rounds', 'Box of 20', '20/25').

title.description: Ammo title, used to read the round count and caliber

tools.name: find_price_comparison_pages
tools.title: Find GunsNPrices price comparison pages
tools.description: Find GunsNPrices pages that compare current prices across 40+ US gun and ammo stores for a firearm model, brand or caliber, e.g. 'Glock 19', 'Sig Sauer P365', 'Ruger', '9mm ammo', '6.5 Creedmoor'. Use it when the user asks where to buy a gun or ammo, or where it is cheapest. Returns the most specific pages first.

tools.name: list_supported
tools.title: List supported brands or calibers
tools.description: List the 50 firearm brands with model recognition, or the 293 known calibers (optionally of one type).
